title: Buffer Solutions & Capacity Bench
learning_goals: Maintain chemical laboratory PPE compliance (goggles, gloves, coat).
Select conjugate acid-base systems whose pKa closely matches target pH.
Prepare buffer solutions using Henderson-Hasselbalch and exact electroneutrality.
Calibrate pH meter with two-point standard buffers before taking measurements.
Determine experimental and theoretical Van Slyke buffer capacity (beta).
Stress-test buffer stability against strong acid and strong base additions.
Recognize buffer exhaustion when added strong titrant exceeds buffer capacity.
Neutralize and safely dispose of chemical waste in designated containers.

rules.text: Full PPE (goggles, gloves, coat) must be worn before touching buffer solutions or corrosive acids/bases.
rules.hint: Put on safety goggles, gloves, and coat before handling buffer reagents.

rules.text: Dispose chemicals into designated chemical waste bin, never in sink.
rules.hint: Always discard spent buffer and acid/base solutions into the chemical waste receptacle.

rules.text: Always wash hands at sink before leaving laboratory bench.
rules.hint: Clean hands with soap and water after handling buffer bench apparatus.

rules.text: Select a buffer system whose pKa is within 1.2 pH units of target pH.
rules.hint: Match buffer pair pKa closely to target pH to provide robust buffer capacity.

rules.text: Calibrate the pH meter before recording buffer and stress test readings.
rules.hint: Standardize the pH meter with two-point standard buffers before measurement.

wear_ppe: Put on goggles, gloves, and lab coat before handling buffer solutions or acids.
select_buffer_system: Select a conjugate pair whose pKa is within 1 pH unit of your desired target pH.
prepare_buffer: Use the Henderson-Hasselbalch equation to calculate the exact acid and conjugate base concentrations.
test_capacity: Calibrate the pH meter before taking initial baseline readings of pH and buffer capacity beta.
stress_buffer: Titrate with 1.0 M HCl or 1.0 M NaOH to observe resistance to pH changes.
submit_buffer_design: Check your prepared pH against target pH and verify that experimental capacity matches theory.
dispose_waste: Pour all acidic, basic, and buffer mixtures into the chemical waste container.
wash_hands: Thoroughly wash hands with soap and water before concluding the lab session.
submit_report: Review your buffer capacity curve and submit your analytical report.

common_mistakes.remedy: Select a buffer pair with pKa within 1 pH unit of target pH for optimal buffer capacity.
